structured.answer: Open an account at Psagot and buy the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" fund. The page says that leaves about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for its example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month at 7%, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: Every fund shows a minus: −0.04%, −0.37%, and −1,030 ₪ etc. next to it. It looked like the funds lose money; I guessed the smallest minus is the best one.
Set to 10,000 and 500, not my 30,000; I didn't change them, so the final number isn't mine.
Couldn't tell if 'less' is good or bad for me.
IBI the account is 11th, but the IBI מחקה fund is the recommended one, and there is also an IBI סל fund. Easy to mix up.
